reasoning_summary: The deterministic verdict for R0 is INCONCLUSIVE with no failed checks, so ACCEPT is not allowed and REJECT is not justified.

R0 passes the averaging and statistics components. The drag averaging bias is 8.688e-05 and the statistics uncertainty is 0.0001028. The Strouhal values are 1.261e-05 and 8.418e-05. All are far below the 0.03 tolerance. Stationary_cycles is 12.
The mesh, time and domain components are all unmeasured, so no combined uncertainty exists for either quantity.

The mesh is the most likely source of an error larger than 3%. R0 has representative_cell_size_D 0.45745 and wake_last_cell_D 1.0209. It has 111 streamwise wake cells and 160 cells around the cylinder. The Strouhal frequency resolution is 0.013342 against a Strouhal number of 0.16351, so frequency resolution is not negligible but is still below 3%.
The time step is a secondary risk. Max Courant is 3.4157, but the backward scheme and 122.32 steps per shedding period suggest decent temporal resolution.

The domain is a smaller risk. Blockage is 0.0125, with 30D upstream, 50D downstream and 40D half-height. The lateral boundary is symmetryPlane, and the inlet and outlet boundary conditions are standard.

I chose REFINE_MESH on R0 at factor 2.0. It has the best chance of changing the answer by more than the tolerance, and a larger factor gives a clearer signal than the 1.4142 default. R0's own cost is 1158.6 s, so a larger cell count fits within the 12x compute budget. Time-step and domain checks remain for later experiments.

The mesh, time and domain components are still unmeasured for both quantities, so no combined uncertainty exists.

The previous REFINE_MESH (factor 2.0 from R0) produced R1, which did not complete. It stopped after 44 time steps at 2.1 convective units, with max_courant 9.2409e+102 and mass_imbalance_max 3.8064e+86. R1 gives no mesh evidence and cannot be used as a parent, since REFINE_MESH, REDUCE_TIME_STEP and RUN_LONGER from R1 are all not allowed or unaffordable.

R1 kept time_step_convective_units 0.05 while its cells_around_cylinder doubled from 160 to 320 and wall_first_cell_D fell from 0.005 to 0.0025143. R0 already ran at max Courant 3.4157. The most likely cause is that Courant number exceeded the stability limit of the PIMPLE setup on the finer mesh.

The courant_number check on R0 is INCONCLUSIVE, because temporal accuracy at Co 3.42 is unproven. A time-step reduction on R0 measures the missing time component directly. It also gives a child run with a smaller dt.

REFINE_MESH keeps the parent's time step. Refining from the smaller-dt child later should therefore be stable at a finer mesh. Repeating REFINE_MESH from R0 would probably diverge again, because dt is unchanged.
R0 has 111 streamwise wake cells and a wake_last_cell_D of 1.0209. The mesh remains a major risk, and it is the next component to measure after the dt child exists.
